issues.title: All Crawled Pages Returned Valid Status
issues.description: No 4xx, 5xx, or network errors were detected among crawled pages.
issues.recommendation: Continue monitoring server logs and internal links regularly.

issues.title: Redirect Chains Detected
issues.description: 49 URL(s) undergo more than one consecutive redirect before reaching the destination page.
issues.recommendation: Update links to point directly to the final destination URL to preserve crawl budget and reduce latency.

issues.title: All Pages Use Secure HTTPS
issues.description: All crawled pages are securely delivered over HTTPS protocol.
issues.recommendation: Ensure SSL/TLS certificates are set to auto-renew.

issues.title: Title Tag Too Short (< 30 characters)
issues.description: 1 page(s) have titles under 30 characters, missing keyword opportunities.
issues.recommendation: Expand title tags to between 30 and 60 characters with descriptive primary keywords and brand name.

issues.title: Title Tag Too Long (> 60 characters)
issues.description: 37 page(s) exceed 60 characters and may be truncated in search engine results.
issues.recommendation: Keep page titles concise (under 60 characters or ~600px pixel width) so they display completely in SERPs.

issues.title: Duplicate Title Tags
issues.description: 4 page(s) share identical title tags, causing keyword cannibalization and confusion for search bots.
issues.recommendation: Assign a unique, topic-specific title to each individual page.

issues.title: Missing Meta Description
issues.description: 50 page(s) do not define a meta description tag.
issues.recommendation: Add compelling meta descriptions (120-155 characters) summarizing the page and enticing search clicks.

issues.title: Multiple H1 Headings on Single Page
issues.description: 37 page(s) have more than one <h1> heading.
issues.recommendation: Reserve <h1> for the primary page title and use <h2> through <h6> for subheadings.

issues.title: Heading Hierarchy Levels Skipped
issues.description: 6 page(s) skip heading levels (e.g., an H1 directly followed by an H4 without intermediate H2/H3).
issues.recommendation: Organize headings logically in sequential order (H1 -> H2 -> H3) for accessibility and crawl structure.

issues.title: Images Missing Descriptive Alt Attribute
issues.description: 147 image(s) across 50 page(s) are missing descriptive alt text.
issues.recommendation: Add meaningful, descriptive alt text to images for image SEO and screen reader accessibility.

issues.title: Missing Open Graph Metadata
issues.description: 50 page(s) lack complete Open Graph tags (og:title or og:image).
issues.recommendation: Add og:title, og:description, and og:image tags for rich preview rendering on social platforms.

issues.title: Low Text-to-HTML Ratio (< 8%)
issues.description: 50 page(s) have an excessive ratio of code markup to actual visible readable content.
issues.recommendation: Streamline inline CSS/JS and expand primary textual copy.

issues.title: Exact Internal Duplicate Content Detected
issues.description: 1 pair(s) of pages have identical textual content (100% hash/shingle match).
issues.recommendation: Consolidate duplicate pages, set canonical tags to the master page, or remove redundant duplicate URLs.

issues.title: Zero Broken Internal Links Found
issues.description: All internal links tested across crawled pages resolved successfully.
issues.recommendation: Periodically re-crawl to catch any newly created broken URLs.

issues.title: robots.txt Valid and Accessible
issues.description: robots.txt is live, accessible, and declares 1 sitemap(s).
issues.recommendation: Continue reviewing robots.txt when adding new private areas.

issues.title: XML Sitemap Discovered
issues.description: Discovered valid XML sitemap containing 80 indexed URLs.
issues.recommendation: Keep sitemap updated automatically via your CMS or build pipeline.
